notes.title: Update 1.0.3
notes.content:
1.Update singleplayer mode, players no longer have to worry about not being able to enter the game for battle.
2.Beautify the UI.

notes.title: Update 1.0.2
notes.content:
1. Change the maximum number of matching players to 2 for easier and faster matching. 
Considering that the current number of players is small, robots will join the game in subsequent versions.
2. Separate locomotion and rotation to two joysticks. You can move forwards、backwards、left 
or right by the left controller, and turn left or right by the right controller.
